name: Engine oil
fluidSpec: Later official 4M41 owner-manual pages show 9.8 L total including filter and cooler; use the correct diesel oil spec and confirm first-service refill on this exact vehicle
symptomsIfNeglected: Sooted oil, timing-chain wear, turbo wear, low pressure
notes: Official schedules disagree by market: one factory Pajero schedule shows 20,000 km/12 mo normal and 10,000 km severe; later Australia schedule shows 15,000 km/12 mo normal and 7,500 km severe. The safe app interval is 7,500 km

name: Oil filter
symptomsIfNeglected: Dirty oil, delayed pressure, increased wear
notes: Do not separate it from oil service on an older 4M41

name: Air cleaner element
symptomsIfNeglected: Smoke, poor power, higher fuel use, turbo dusting risk
notes: Official severe-use regime is shorter in dust and off-road use

name: Air cleaner element
symptomsIfNeglected: Restricted airflow, smoke, turbo contamination
notes: Factory schedule gives 40,000 km normal for diesel; on an old off-road truck 20,000 km is safer

name: Fuel filter
symptomsIfNeglected: Hard start, surging, rail-pressure faults, pump wear
notes: Later Australia schedule points to about 30,000 km; conservative app value is 20,000 km/12 mo

name: Fuel-filter water / contamination
symptomsIfNeglected: Filter lamp, hesitation, corrosion in injection parts
notes: Check immediately if the fuel-filter lamp or water warning appears

name: Coolant level and cooling system
fluidSpec: Match coolant chemistry, do not mix unknown types
symptomsIfNeglected: Overheating, heater weakness, hidden coolant loss
notes: On LWB vehicles, rear heater pipes are a known corrosion leak point

name: Coolant
fluidSpec: Exact 2001 V78W refill figure was not cleanly verifiable from accessible factory pages; confirm actual refill on first measured service
symptomsIfNeglected: Corrosion, overheating, water-pump wear
notes: Store the vehicle-confirmed refill amount in the app after the first flush

name: Thermostat / radiator / main hoses
symptomsIfNeglected: Slow warm-up, unstable temp, overheating, coolant smell
notes: No clean factory replacement interval found; treat as condition-based but inspect at every coolant service

name: Accessory belts
fluidSpec: Later factory 4M41 procedure gives measured tension values
symptomsIfNeglected: Squeal, no charging, poor cooling
notes: Especially important because the 4M41 belt condition affects alternator and cooling support systems

name: Accessory belts
symptomsIfNeglected: Belt breakage, charging loss, overheating
notes: No exact factory replacement interval found in the accessible 2001 material; use age-based preventive replacement

name: Belt pulleys / idlers / tensioners
symptomsIfNeglected: Chirp, rough bearing noise, belt throw
notes: Replace with belts if any roughness or wobble is found

name: Vacuum-pump oil hose
symptomsIfNeglected: Oil seepage, vacuum-related issues
notes: Explicitly listed in the factory diesel maintenance schedule

name: Intake air hose / turbo oil hose / intercooler path
symptomsIfNeglected: Boost leaks, oily misting, poor power
notes: Check charge-air hoses and intercooler for oil accumulation and leaks

name: Turbocharger
symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, smoke, power loss, oil use
notes: Inspect shaft play and compressor condition when intake hoses are removed

name: Crankcase ventilation / breather hoses
symptomsIfNeglected: Oil mist, manifold sludge, external seepage
notes: Oil mist from the breather mixes with EGR soot and forms the 4M41 intake sludge seen by owners

name: EGR system
symptomsIfNeglected: Low-speed hesitation, smoke, sticky intake parts
notes: Factory schedule includes an EGR inspection item; many older vehicles benefit from periodic cleaning

name: Intake manifold carbon buildup
symptomsIfNeglected: Power loss, smoke, airflow restriction
notes: Community consensus is that manifold cross-section can reduce badly if EGR and oil mist are left alone

name: Glow plugs
symptomsIfNeglected: Hard cold start, white smoke, cold misfire
notes: No verified fixed replacement interval found; treat as condition-based test item

name: Injectors / small injection quantity learning
fluidSpec: In applicable common-rail factory documentation, new injectors require code entry
symptomsIfNeglected: Rough idle, smoke, knock, economy loss
notes: The later factory schedule explicitly includes small-injection-quantity learning; store completed learning in service history

name: Supply pump / SCV / rail-pressure system
symptomsIfNeglected: Surging, stalling, hard starting, reduced power
notes: Community pattern strongly links 4M41 surging and light-throttle hunting to SCV/fuel-pressure control faults

name: Valve clearance
symptomsIfNeglected: Ticking, rough idle, starting trouble
notes: The later official 4M41 schedule lists valve-clearance inspection every 20,000 km/12 mo; many owners defer it, but the factory interval is the safest app value

name: Timing chain / guides / tensioner
fluidSpec: Factory bulletin identifies 4M41 timing-chain kits and replacement procedure
symptomsIfNeglected: Cold-start rattle, metallic timing noise, catastrophic failure if ignored
notes: 4M41 uses a chain, not a belt; early Gen 3 community/specialist reports repeatedly warn about top-guide wear and breakage

name: Engine mounts / oil-pressure-switch leak / general 4M41 high-mileage checks
parts: Mounts or oil-pressure switch as needed
symptomsIfNeglected: Vibration, sudden oil leak near turbo/block, clunks
notes: The oil-pressure switch leak is a recurring 4M41 complaint and should be checked at every oil service

name: ATF level and condition
fluidSpec: Use ATF SP III only; later 5AT owner-manual page shows 9.7 L total on a later Pajero, so confirm first-service refill for this V5A51
symptomsIfNeglected: Burnt smell, slip, flare, delayed engagement
notes: Check hot and log colour/odour in the app

name: ATF
fluidSpec: Exact 2001 V5A51 total-fill figure was not cleanly verified; use measured refill volumes on first major service
symptomsIfNeglected: Harsh or soft shifts, shudder, temp warning
notes: Official sources disagree because some later schedules refer to newer 5AT calibrations. For a 2001 V5A51, 40,000 km / 3 years is the safe app interval

name: Internal filter / strainer / pan service
fluidSpec: V5A51 workshop manual shows an internal oil filter, oil strainer, magnets and sealant on the pan, not a simple serviceable external filter
symptomsIfNeglected: Debris circulation, poor shift quality, contaminated ATF
notes: On unknown history, do an early pan-drop service rather than assuming "sealed for life"

name: Cooler lines and cooler / heat exchanger
symptomsIfNeglected: ATF leak, overheating, low fluid
notes: Extra important if towing or driving slowly off-road

name: ATF service method on unknown history
symptomsIfNeglected: Post-service shift problems if done badly
notes: Community and specialist threads favour pan service plus staged drain-and-fills or a controlled specialist flush over a blind aggressive machine flush on a neglected older box

name: Transfer case oil
symptomsIfNeglected: Chain/bearing wear, noisy case, poor shifting
notes: Do not use rear-diff GL-5 as the default transfer oil unless a verified equivalent specifically covers the factory requirement

name: Transfer case oil leakage / level
symptomsIfNeglected: Low oil, whining, oil misting
notes: Official schedule includes leak/level checks

name: Super Select 4WD functional exercise
symptomsIfNeglected: Flashing lamps, sticky engagement, reluctant mode changes
notes: Community consensus is clear: regular exercise helps keep the system free

name: Front axle actuator / vacuum lines / vacuum solenoids
symptomsIfNeglected: Flashing front-wheel lamps, failure to engage/disengage, grinding
notes: One of the best-documented Gen 3 real-world fault patterns

name: 4WD switches and sensors / indicator diagnosis
fluidSpec: V5A51 transfer documentation lists 2WD, 4H, centre-diff-lock and 4LLc-related switches
symptomsIfNeglected: Persistent blinking lamps, false mode display
notes: Sticky or worn detection switches are a common Gen 3 cause of flashing lights

name: Front differential oil
symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, bearing wear
notes: Official check method says oil should not be more than 8 mm below filler-hole lower edge

name: Rear differential oil
fluidSpec: GL-5 SAE 80 or 90, 1.6 L for the standard rear diff shown in factory material
symptomsIfNeglected: Whine, gear wear, chatter if wrong lube used
notes: Verify whether this exact vehicle has an LSD or locker before final fluid assignment

name: Rear LSD / locker verification
symptomsIfNeglected: Wrong oil selection, poor locking behaviour
notes: V78W equipment varies by market/trim; confirm hardware before hard-coding fluid SKUs in the app

name: Prop shafts, U-joints and slip joints
symptomsIfNeglected: Clunk, vibration, seized U-joints
notes: Factory schedule explicitly includes propeller-shaft greasing

name: CV boots and axle seals
symptomsIfNeglected: Grease fling, clicks, oil contamination
notes: Severe-use schedule shortens boots checks

name: Wheel bearings
symptomsIfNeglected: Rumble, wheel play, hot hub, ABS issues
notes: Community experience repeatedly warns against poor-quality aftermarket bearings on Gen 3/4 Pajeros

name: Brake fluid
fluidSpec: DOT 3 or DOT 4 from a sealed container
symptomsIfNeglected: Soft pedal, corrosion, poor HBB/ABS behaviour
notes: More important than average because this vehicle uses a hydraulic brake booster system

name: Pads and discs
symptomsIfNeglected: Noise, pull, vibration, reduced braking
notes: Official severe-use schedule shortens brake inspection

name: Calipers and guide pins
symptomsIfNeglected: Uneven pad wear, dragging brakes
notes: Common ageing-service item even though not listed as a separate factory replacement row

name: Parking brake (drum-in-disc)
symptomsIfNeglected: Long travel, poor hill-hold
notes: Store post-adjustment lever travel in the app if possible

name: Brake hoses and hard lines
symptomsIfNeglected: Cracks, leaks, sudden line failure
notes: Pay extra attention to rear sections and wheel-arch exits on salted-road vehicles

name: ABS / HBB code scan and warning-lamp diagnosis
symptomsIfNeglected: ABS lamp, brake lamp, buzzer, pump cycling
notes: Log codes in the app, not just parts replaced

name: HBB pump operation and accumulator health
symptomsIfNeglected: Long pump run, buzzing, hard pedal, warning lamp
notes: Factory troubleshooting sets code 55 if the pump motor runs for 300 seconds and code 57 if accumulator pressure is too low

name: HBB accumulator / pump motor / relays
symptomsIfNeglected: Warning buzzer, poor reserve assist, repeated pump run
notes: Community and official diagnostic trees both show this is one of the major Gen 3 braking weak points

name: Suspension system general
symptomsIfNeglected: Clunks, looseness, tyre wear
notes: Good baseline under-vehicle inspection item

name: Upper and lower ball joints / dust boots
symptomsIfNeglected: Play, knock, alignment drift
notes: One of the must-check front-end items on a high-mileage Gen 3

name: Control-arm bushes / stabiliser links / stabiliser bushes
symptomsIfNeglected: Harshness, small-bump rattles, wandering
notes: No separate factory replacement interval; inspect with every suspension check

name: Tie rods / steering linkage / seals and boots
symptomsIfNeglected: Steering play, toe wear, wandering
notes: Factory schedule includes steering-linkage inspection

name: Steering-column joints / intermediate shaft
symptomsIfNeglected: Column clunk, notchiness
notes: Less common than tie-rod wear but worth annual attention on an ageing truck

name: Shocks and springs / ride height
symptomsIfNeglected: Bounce, float, rear sag
notes: High-mileage owner experience regularly points to softness before obvious leakage

name: Wheel alignment
symptomsIfNeglected: Tyre wear, pull, off-centre wheel
notes: Recheck after any ball-joint, bush or shock work

name: Chassis and underbody corrosion
symptomsIfNeglected: Structural rust, seized fixings
notes: Must be annual at minimum on salted-road European vehicles

name: Brake-line and fuel-line corrosion points
symptomsIfNeglected: Wet lines, scale, MOT failure
notes: Concentrate on rear wheel-arch exits and underbody channels

name: Rear wheel arches / sills / door bottoms / tailgate seams
symptomsIfNeglected: Bubble rust, hidden seam corrosion
notes: Common hidden-rust zones on ageing Pajero/Shogun bodies

name: Fuel-tank area / straps / nearby lines
parts: Tank straps or hardware as needed
symptomsIfNeglected: Rust at tank cradle, seepage
notes: Mud and salt collect here

name: Body mounts and fasteners
symptomsIfNeglected: Body movement, clunks, seized mount bolts
notes: Important before heavy rustproofing or major chassis work

name: Sunroof drains
symptomsIfNeglected: Wet headlining, damp carpets
notes: If fitted, treat as annual preventive maintenance

name: Underbody wax / cavity protection
symptomsIfNeglected: Rust progression each winter
notes: Best done after cleaning and drying, not over trapped damp corrosion

name: Rear heater pipes / rear HVAC hard lines
symptomsIfNeglected: Coolant loss, weak rear heat/cool, underbody rust
notes: Very common long-wheelbase issue and worth its own app reminder

name: Battery state / electrolyte / case condition
symptomsIfNeglected: Slow crank, low-voltage faults, HBB/ABS nuisance faults
notes: Later owner/manual material says serviceable batteries should be checked very regularly; six-month app checks are sensible even if a battery tester is not used every time

name: Alternator charging voltage / belt load
symptomsIfNeglected: Dim lamps, battery not charging
notes: Record actual charging voltage in service notes

name: Grounds / earth points / starter cables
symptomsIfNeglected: Slow crank, strange sensor faults, intermittent electrical issues
notes: Age and corrosion make this a very worthwhile preventive task

name: Fuses / relays / lighting / dash warning bulbs
symptomsIfNeglected: Hidden faults if warning lamps do not work
notes: Important because 4WD and HBB systems often rely on dash warnings

name: OBD / MUT scan of engine, A/T, ABS/HBB and 4WD
symptomsIfNeglected: Hidden pending faults, no-code drivability issues
notes: Store codes and freeze-frame notes, not just a "done" flag

name: Common failing engine-control sensors
symptomsIfNeglected: Surging, no-start, reduced power, oil leak
notes: Community reports repeatedly mention SCV, MAF/MAP, crank-angle/rpm signal problems and oil-pressure-switch leakage on 4M41s

name: Cabin / air-purifier filter
symptomsIfNeglected: Weak airflow, odour, fogging
notes: One of the cleanest verified factory intervals available

name: A/C service / leak test / refrigerant service
fluidSpec: Later owner-manual snippets show HFC-134a and later-model fill figures, but exact 2001 V78W charge must be confirmed from the under-bonnet label
symptomsIfNeglected: Warm air, poor cooling, noisy compressor
notes: Do not hard-code later-model refrigerant mass into the app without checking this vehicle's label

name: Condenser / evaporator drain / blower motor / heater core / rear heater
parts: blower parts or hose parts if needed
symptomsIfNeglected: Odour, wet carpets, weak airflow, coolant smell
notes: Rear heater plumbing on the long-wheelbase vehicle deserves special attention

name: Seat mechanisms
symptomsIfNeglected: Stiff adjusters
notes: Annual cabin-detail task

name: Locks, hinges, bonnet and tailgate latches
symptomsIfNeglected: Stiff locks, latch wear
notes: Good before winter and after washing or rustproofing

name: Window regulators and channels
symptomsIfNeglected: Slow windows, grinding, dropped glass
notes: Check drain membranes if doors are damp inside

name: Wiper blades and washer system
symptomsIfNeglected: Streaking, blocked jets, poor visibility
notes: Some Pajeros have rear washer reservoir/service points in the back door area

name: Tailgate / spare carrier / back-door hardware
symptomsIfNeglected: Door sag, rattles, seized fasteners
notes: Important on vehicles carrying weight on the rear door or spare mount
